title: Hold, Resumption, Discharge and Closure of an Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Insured Plan of Care — status rules after activation.**

**Hold.** An active plan is placed on hold with the matching hold reason when its authorization is pending, exhausted or ended, when its certification has lapsed, when surgery is pending, when the patient asks to pause, or when no visit has been billed for the payer program's inactivity period in calendar days.

**Resumption.** A plan on hold resumes once the recorded reason is resolved.

**Discharge for non-attendance.** A plan on hold is discharged for non-attendance no earlier than the payer program's hold limit, in calendar days, after the hold start date on file. Days are counted as calendar days from the hold start date, the hold start date itself being day zero. An active plan is also discharged when the treating therapist discharges the patient from the plan of care.

**After discharge.** The discharge summary is sent to the referring provider within the payer program's discharge summary period, in calendar days, after discharge, and any appointments still booked under the plan are released.

**Closure.** A discharged plan is closed once its patient balance is zero and none of its charges sits in a Patient Payment Plan that is still pending signature, active, past due or defaulted. A plan still in intake is closed when its initial authorization is denied or the patient declines to proceed.

**Evidence.** The hold start date is read from the plan's system record.

## Discharge timing — boundary (hypothetical dates, 30-calendar-day hold limit)

| Hold start date | Date considered | Day count | Discharge for non-attendance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-01 (day zero) | 2026-06-30 | day 29 | Not yet |
| 2026-06-01 (day zero) | 2026-07-01 | day 30 | Allowed from this day |

## Closing a discharged plan — truth table

| Patient balance on the plan | A charge in a Patient Payment Plan pending signature, active, past due or defaulted | Closed |
|---|---|---|
| Zero | No | Yes |
| Zero | Yes | No |
| Not zero | — | No |
